translations.en: You received a @3rGreatsword@0r.
Good work. I'd say we found something worthwhile.
I'll get to work deciphering this.
We went through a lot to get it,
so I can't afford to overlook anything.
Thanks for helping me search.
Here's something for your trouble. Take it.
From @7rCarmine@0r, you received @3r15,000 G@0r and a @3rGreatsword@0r.
See you around.
From @7rCarmine@0r, you received @3r15,000 G@0r.
I'm ready to go,
so let's get moving. We're wasting time.
Will you join the expedition to find @7rChu Lu Gah's@0r house
and help me look for it?
You're looking for information too, aren't you?
I'd really like your help. What do you say?
You hesitate, feeling as though you are weighing @7rCarmine@0r against @7rBeatrix@0r,
but solving this mystery is bound to require
all kinds of information.
Since you need to gather information now,
you realize you cannot afford to be choosy,
and decide to accept the request.
Thanks for agreeing to help.
Let's find out everything we can about @7rChu Lu Gah@0r!
We'll explore the newly discovered ruins too,
but if this was where he lived, I doubt it would be
somewhere inconvenient, far from the city.
When @7rBeatrix@0r found the name of the new ruined city, @6rBahelmeja@0r,
she said @7rChu Lu Gah's@0r diary
had mentioned a similar name.
The legends about @7rChu Lu Gah@0r mention @6rBahelmeja@0r too.
I don't know if it's connected,
but there's also a place called Kulgar Straat.
translations.note: Kulgar Straat is an editorial romanization; retain the same display wording on street signs.

translations.en: Hey, @7rCyrus@0r, you've got some good information yourself.
I also dug up the name
translations.note: Dulong Straat is an editorial romanization; retain the same display wording on street signs.

translations.en: Dulong Straat. Those two names are our key.
Straat meant "street" in the language of that time.
If we can find a sign or something, we should be able to locate them.
I know it's a lot to ask with so little to go on,
but we won't get anywhere unless we try.
Let's give it our best shot!
No, huh? Is it because you don't trust me...
or is it something else?
Well, after that whole business with the seal, I can't blame you.
But I really can't carry out this search without your help.
Adventurers with your skills aren't easy to find.
I'll be waiting for you to say yes,
so please think it over.
